name: analyze_function
description: Build a dossier for one native function identified by symbol or provider-returned address. Returns identity with complete inclusive analyzed body ranges or explicit unknown, provider-specific pseudocode and assembly, comments, calls, references, referenced strings/names, local CFG blocks, and available native API boundary observations. Ghidra terminal-call assumptions that may cut the analyzed body are reported in limitations with available callee identities. Default detail summary returns a compact dossier (identity, pseudocode size, facet counts, value-flow availability) and retains the complete dossier Evidence in this session; page pseudocode, references, assembly, comments and value-flow through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id with inspect_analysis_view. detail complete returns the full dossier inline.

detail.description: summary (default) returns a compact dossier and retains the complete analyze_function Evidence in this session; page pseudocode, references and value-flow through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id with inspect_analysis_view. complete returns the full dossier inline.
